generic_domain.justification: Cooperative learning is the most generic because it can encompass both cooperative multi-agent learning and cooperative reinforcement learning. It refers to methodologies where multiple entities, such as agents or learners, work together to achieve a common goal. Cooperative multi-agent learning deals with interactions among multiple agents in a shared environment, while cooperative reinforcement learning applies reinforcement techniques within a cooperative setting. Since cooperative learning is the broader concept, it serves as an umbrella for these more specific domains.
